subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Should the current-main Ollama compaction repair wait for the next normal release, or be backported to a v2026.7.x patch release for affected stable users?
rationale: The code path reportedly succeeds after v2026.7.1, but users on the latest release remain affected; choosing the release vehicle and accepting backport risk requires release-owner intent.

options.title: Ship Next Release
options.body: Identify the fix SHA, confirm focused regression coverage, and include it in the next normal release while documenting that v2026.7.1 remains affected.

options.title: Backport to v2026.7.x
options.body: Cherry-pick the narrow fix into a patch release after validating both normal and explicit-session Ollama compaction on the release branch.

recommendation.title: Ship Next Release
recommendation.body: Identify the fix SHA, confirm focused regression coverage, and include it in the next normal release while documenting that v2026.7.1 remains affected.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline routes the report to them and the remaining question is release inclusion rather than a new implementation.
